name: The Looney Tunes Show
description: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the “Looney Tunes” characters are back with more adventures for a new generation of viewers. The animated series features roommates Bugs and Daffy moving out of the woods and into the suburbs, interacting with their neighbors, who happen to be other "Looney Tunes" favorites -- including Sylvester, Tweety, Porky Pig and Foghorn Leghorn.

credits_cast.character: Bugs Bunny / Daffy Duck / Tweety / Sylvester (voice)

videos.overview: Go behind the scenes of The Looney Tunes Show for new-era music videos with singer guest stars with Supervising Producer Tony Cervone and Head Writer, Hugh Davidson and DJ Host Lola Bunny (voiced by Kristen Wiig). Catch The Looney Tunes Show this Fall on Cartoon Network! Go behind the scenes of the animated sitcom The Looney Tunes Show at Comic-Con 2014.

videos.title: Best Friends
videos.overview: Bugs and Daffy enter a game show that focuses on best friends, but Daffy's bottomless stupidity causes them to lose, which in turn causes him to try and be more like a friend to Bugs. But as expected, he tries way too hard.

videos.title: Members Only
videos.overview: When Daffy realizes the country club is open to members only, he determines to gain access and take full advantage of all it offers. Bugs meets his dream girl: Lola Bunny.

videos.title: Jailbird... and Jailbunny
videos.overview: Daffy littering the Grand Canyon ultimately sends him and Bugs to jail, which Bugs grows a liking to, but Daffy hates. This causes some conflict when they get the chance to escape.

videos.title: Fish and Visitors
videos.overview: Bugs and Daffy quickly discover that Yosemite Sam is a less-than-perfect houseguest when they are forced to take him in during a rainstorm. But how to get him to leave?

videos.title: Monster Talent
videos.overview: Daffy takes Gossamer under his wing, while Bugs stars in a TV commercial for Speedy's new frozen pizza. Plus, the Coyote attempts to capture the Road Runner using a zipline.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: When Daffy doesn't want to go to his class reunion because he feels he peaked in high school, Bugs tries to help him make something of himself before the big night.

videos.title: Casa de Calma
videos.overview: Instead of relaxing during a spa vacation, Bugs and Daffy spend most of their time fighting over a Hollywood starlet.

videos.title: Devil Dog
videos.overview: When the Tasmanian Devil escapes from the local zoo and shows up on Bugs and Daffy's doorstep, Daffy is terrified. Bugs, however, thinks he's just a lost dog and adopts him.

videos.title: The Foghorn Leghorn Story
videos.overview: Foghorn Leghorn casts Daffy as himself in a movie about his life. Meanwhile, Bugs and Yosemite Sam find a potentially valuable vase buried in the backyard.

videos.title: Eligible Bachelors
videos.overview: Lola sweeps Bugs to Paris in an effort to fall in love and Daffy discovers that Granny was once a spy in World War II! The coyote tries to catch the Road Runner via speed skating.

videos.title: Peel of Fortune
videos.overview: After learning about the invention that got Bugs rich, Daffy produces an improvement on it that ends up defective, sending him and Bugs into a financial crisis.

videos.title: Double Date
videos.overview: Lola gives Daffy dating advice, and falls in love with him in the process. But Daffy only has eyes for Tina, and Bugs is surprised to find he might actually have feelings for Lola.

videos.title: To Bowl or Not to Bowl
videos.overview: Daffy has found some bowling friends: Marvin, Pete, and Porky. Bugs threatens to end that, which means problems when they enter a bowling tournament, which Bugs joins after Porky is hospitalized.

videos.title: Newspaper Thief
videos.overview: Daffy has caused so much destruction in the neighborhood, that Bugs has thrown a dinner party so Daffy can say sorry. This won't be easy, as Daffy suspects one of the neighbors of newspaper thievery.

videos.title: Bugs and Daffy Get a Job
videos.overview: Bugs gets a job alongside Porky at a boring office to cheer him up. Daffy also gets a job, but not one where he has to work. He gets a nose job.

videos.title: That's My Baby
videos.overview: When Tina asks Daffy to babysit her nephew, Daffy discovers the unexpected joys of motherhood. Meanwhile, Bugs discovers how gullible Porky can be.

videos.title: Sunday Night Slice
videos.overview: When Bugs and Daffy's favorite pizza joint closes, Bugs reopens it ... and gets in way over his head.

videos.title: DMV
videos.overview: After they all get ticketed for moving violations, Daffy, Lola and Porky have to apply for new licenses at the Department of Motor Vehicles while Bugs can't get a lift home.

videos.title: Off Duty Cop
videos.overview: Daffy takes on the persona of his television hero, Steve St. James, while Bugs takes on his caffeine addiction, by switching to energy drinks.

videos.title: Working Duck
videos.overview: When Foghorn Leghorn takes a liking to Daffy he makes him the CEO of his company ... with disastrous results.

videos.title: French Fries
videos.overview: A plate of French fries threatens to ruin Daffy and Porky's friendship, as well as Bugs' chance to see a playoff game. Plus, Lola sings about her favorite holiday of the year.

videos.title: Beauty School
videos.overview: Daffy helps Tina earn her cosmetology license, while Bugs helps Porky learn to dance. Plus, Daffy explains the meaning of love to Porky.

videos.title: The Float
videos.overview: After a car wash accident on his parade float, Daffy swindles Porky out of all his savings in order to obtain a yacht to replace the parade float. Plus, the Gophers sing about what makes them best friends ... to a Bossa Nova beat.

videos.title: The Shelf
videos.overview: Bugs tries to hang a shelf to display his Nobel Prize, but the project gets complicated. Daffy explains to Porky why a birthday gift was "chintzy."

videos.title: The Muh-Muh-Muh-Murder
videos.overview: Daffy suspects that Porky is a killer, and Bugs has to take care of Lola when she breaks her leg.

videos.title: Point, Laser Point
videos.overview: Sylvester becomes obsessed with a laser toy. The Coyote orders the ultimate trap, and actually catches the Road Runner ... now if he could just get him out!

videos.title: Bobcats on Three
videos.overview: Daffy coaches Gossamer’s water polo team despite having no experience. Meanwhile, Bugs becomes addicted to Porky’s unhealthy, butter-loaded catering.

videos.title: You've Got Hate Mail
videos.overview: Daffy accidentally emails a letter to everyone he knows explaining what’s wrong with them and must suffer the consequences. Lola and her parents want Bugs in their family photo.

videos.title: Itsy Bitsy Gopher
videos.overview: When one of the Gophers is reported missing, Daffy and Lola take the case to look for him. Meanwhile, Bugs nearly destroys his home trying to kill a spider.

videos.title: Rebel Without a Glove
videos.overview: When Bugs loses his gloves, the motorcycle gloves he gets as a replacement lead him to the life of a rebel. Meanwhile, Daffy is accidentally hired as a college professor.

videos.title: Semper Lie
videos.overview: When Bugs tells a small lie to Porky, it gathers steam to make everything far worse — it even prompts Daffy to join the U.S. Marines.

videos.title: Father Figure
videos.overview: Volunteering in the Father Figure program, Porky is matched up with the troubled Henry Hawk and Foghorn is paired up with Daffy, who may have lied about his age. Meanwhile, Bugs and Walter train for a tennis match.

videos.title: Customer Service
videos.overview: When Cecil Turtle, a customer service representative, intentionally cuts off Bugs’ cable TV, Bugs declares war. Meanwhile, Daffy tries to get a job as a customer service representative supervisor.

videos.title: The Stud, the Nerd, the Average Joe, and the Saint
videos.overview: Porky decides to run a marathon, threatening Daffy’s definition of everyone’s roles in their circle of friends. Meanwhile, Yosemite Sam wants to save Bugs' life because Bugs saved his.

videos.title: It's a Handbag
videos.overview: Daffy’s world is turned upside-down when his handbag is stolen at the mall, prompting him to hire Porky as his full-time bodyguard. Lola searches the globe for the anniversary gift for Bugs.

videos.title: A Christmas Carol
videos.overview: When the overwhelming heat zaps everyone's enthusiasm for Christmas, Lola decides to stage her own version of A Christmas Carol to renew the town's holiday spirit, while Foghorn and Daffy set off for the North Pole to set up a giant fan that will blow cold air down to their sweltering town.

videos.title: We're in Big Truffle
videos.overview: While babysitting, Lola reads a spell book as a bedtime story to Gossamer and turns him into a frog. Meanwhile, a get-rich-quick scheme gets Daffy and Porky attacked by a giant bear.

videos.title: Dear John
videos.overview: Lola joins a monastery and Bugs buys a boat to sail around the world when they each mistakenly believe the other has ended their relationship. Meanwhile, Daffy runs against Porky for City Council.

videos.title: Daffy Duck Esquire
videos.overview: When Tina’s dad comes to town, Daffy decides to pretend he is a lawyer in order to impress him. Bugs must pretend to be Daffy’s slacker roommate.

videos.title: Spread Those Wings and Fly
videos.overview: Daffy and Porky attend a self-help seminar, which inspires Daffy to want to learn how to fly. When that doesn’t work, he settles for becoming an airline flight attendant.

videos.title: The Black Widow
videos.overview: Daffy drags Porky along on spring break when nobody else will go with him and the two quickly end up in jail in a small town in Mexico.

videos.title: Mrs. Porkbunny's
videos.overview: Tensions flare when Bugs and Porky start a business together selling carrot cake. Daffy decides to become an actor in commercials since it is easy, high-paying work.

videos.title: Gribbler's Quest
videos.overview: Daffy must shake an online shopping addiction when he uses Bugs’ computer to do his online shopping. Daffy is dragged by Yosemite Sam into a group therapy. Bugs is addicted to a video game called Gribbler’s Quest.

videos.title: The Grand Old Duck of York
videos.overview: Daffy takes piano lessons from Granny. As a result, Bugs gets noise-cancelling earbuds and quickly realizes he can tune out everything.

videos.title: Ridiculous Journey
videos.overview: After accidentally getting shipped to Alaska, the Tasmanian Devil, Tweety and Sylvester must put aside their differences and make an incredible journey together to return to their happy homes.

videos.title: The Shell Game
videos.overview: Cecil Turtle returns with a broken shell scam that he uses to con Bugs out of money. Meanwhile, when Daffy’s beloved recliner breaks, he and Lola search for a replacement.

videos.title: Year of the Duck
videos.overview: Daffy is highly insulted when he discovers that ducks are not included in the Chinese zodiac, and attempt to make ducks more popular.

videos.title: Gossamer Is Awesomer
videos.overview: Daffy becomes campaign manager for Gossamer’s run for Class President. Porky moves in with Bugs and Daffy after his catering business goes broke, and spends his days reorganizing everything.

videos.title: Here Comes the Pig
videos.overview: Daffy convinces Porky that they should go on a road trip to Porky’s third grade girlfriend’s wedding in an attempt to win her back after all these years.

videos.title: Mr. Weiner
videos.overview: Daffy enters a hot dog eating contest to try and win the title “Mr. Weiner” and Bugs gets roped into helping Yosemite Sam attempt to jump a school bus over a row of motorcycles.

videos.title: Best Friends Redux
videos.overview: When Bugs meets up with a old friend named Rodney Rabbit, Daffy gets jealous and uses the time vortex at Witch Lezah's to go back in time and ensure Bugs and Rodney never become friends. Meanwhile, Porky Pig wonders about his ranking in Daffy Duck's list of best friends.

videos.title: SuperRabbit
videos.overview: Bugs tells the story of SuperRabbit, with himself as SuperRabbit, Elmer Fudd as Lex Luthor, and Daffy as Zod, and explains why he gave up the SuperLife.

awards: Nominated for 3 Primetime Emmys. 5 wins & 19 nominations total
